name: s332
signature: int s332(const int *a, int *out_index, int *out_chksum, int t, int n)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup.
contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added. Scalar output slots are pairwise disjoint and disjoint from every array.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.empty_input: No array writes; return -1, with out_index=-2 and out_chksum=-3.
contract.notes: First value strictly greater than t. Preserve no-match value=-1, index=-2, and checksum=-3, including for n=0.

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
expose temp's scalar observation as the return value
expose reviewed local scalar state and dummy observation in disjoint output slots

testing.description: Data in [-3,3]; zero, one, minus-one, alternating, and seeded random trials.
